general.notes: Typical reach 80 km limited by power budget; 120 km limited by dispersion compensation; 300 km extended mode set through host in Low Power mode (+0.2 W power consumption). Power budget 0–22 dB. Transmitter/receiver output and input powers are average (footnote 4). Minimum input power unamplified at BER per general definitions (normally 1E-12) with OSNR >35 dB/0.1 nm (footnotes 5–6); 100G DQPSK SC-FEC. Amplified minimum input -18 dBm; extended range -22 dBm with Rx input power range where performance guaranteed with <1 dB OSNR penalty relative to Rx OSNR tolerance limit (footnote 7). Dispersion ±6000 ps/nm applies to extended mode (footnote 3). Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Media FEC SC-FEC latency 17 µs. Rx power monitor: signal -21 dBm to +3 dBm; total -21 dBm to +6 dBm.
general.suggestions: Wavelength range is given only in THz (191.35–196.10); nm fields left null. Consider mapping power budget 0–22 dB if added to schema. Footnote 7 describes OSNR penalty qualitatively but lacks a tabular penalized value for structured penalties.
